name: Tom Thumb

attributes.attribute: a man no taller than a thumb
a mortal of the fairy kind

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Tom Thumb is a small man of the old tale of Britain. He is no taller than the thumb of a man. The tale of the small folk fits the lore of the fairies. He came to the court of King Arthur at Camelot. He rode inside a salmon meant for the king's supper. He has as true a heart as any man.

okr.objective: Record the tiny man of the old tale.
key_results: He is no taller than a thumb
He came to the court of the king
He rode in the belly of a salmon
